name: Rallly
description: Self-hosted scheduling tool for organizing group polls and finding a meeting time that works.

envVars.description: Session encryption secret, 32 characters or more

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://rallly:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/rallly"
      NEXTAUTH_URL: "http://localhost:8136"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      SECRET_PASSWORD: {{env.SECRET_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/app/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: rallly
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: rallly
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
